title: See the investment inside the house
about: The RoomIQ story film for the hero of index.html. Every claim maps to GTM-BRIEF.md Section 5 (Saasrelaunchdev/roomIQGTMBuild, main) or to this page's own copy; every house, market and figure is the page's made-up sample. See brief.md and beats.md.

lines.text: You run a few houses by the room, and you run them well.
lines.claim: The buyer: small co-living operators running rent-by-the-room homes (GTM icp_dashboard.xlsx, Level 1)
lines.shows: Lakeview from above in morning light, the camera pushing in to one of the operator's houses: lit rooms, a renter waving from the path, the operator carrying a lamp up to the door

lines.text: Now you've found the next one, a six-bedroom house near the greenway.
lines.source: The page's demo house: 1207 Greenway Drive, Lakeview, a house with 6 bedrooms and 4 baths (index.html, product previews, made up)
lines.shows: the camera glides along Greenway Drive to a bigger house with a For sale sign; a pill: 1207 Greenway Drive, 6 bedrooms, 4 baths

lines.text: So you work it out the way everyone does: rooms, times weekly rent, times occupancy.
lines.claim: The page's napkin: 'Rooms, times weekly rent, times occupancy. It's the right first question.' (index.html #napkin)
lines.shows: the operator at her desk in the evening; the napkin card builds the formula term by term on 'rooms', 'weekly rent' and 'occupancy'

lines.text: That's the right formula. But you picked the rent yourself, and the ninety percent is a guess.
lines.source: The page's napkin calculator: 6 rooms, $200/wk picked with a slider, occupancy assumed at 90% (index.html #napkin, 'You picked the rent with a slider, and the calculator assumed the occupancy')
lines.shows: $200/wk gets the amber tag 'you picked it' on 'picked'; 90% gets 'a guess' on 'guess'; $4,698 a month stands as the result

lines.text: And nobody has counted the other houses renting rooms nearby.
lines.shows: a third row: 'Supply nearby ?' tagged 'never counted'; the camera turns to the window, the town at night with many lit windows nobody has counted

lines.text: You make the offer on those numbers, and the house is yours.
lines.claim: The decision point: an offer on a candidate house (GTM icp_dashboard.xlsx, Triggers: evaluating the next property)
lines.shows: she presses Send offer; a pill 'Offer sent' with the question marks still on the numbers; cut to the house: a Sold sign drops on the For sale sign

lines.text: Then the rooms go up for rent, and two of them sit empty for weeks.
lines.claim: Status-quo pain, dramatized on the made-up house: 'a house that filled slower than the spreadsheet said' (GTM assets_library.xlsx, pain-stack hooks)
lines.shows: the roof lifts off 1207 Greenway Drive; four rooms glow warm with renters inside, two stay dark with amber chips 'Vacant, week 3'

lines.text: Seventeen other houses within three miles were renting rooms all along.
lines.source: The page's demo location screen: 17 active co-living properties within about 3 mi of 1207 Greenway Drive (index.html screens.location, made up)
lines.shows: the camera rises over the town; a dashed ring of about three miles draws around the house; seventeen houses inside it light up one by one with a counter to 17; renters walk to them

lines.text: If your rooms fill seventy-five percent of the time instead of ninety percent, that's seven hundred eighty-three dollars a month off your plan.
lines.source: The page's own arithmetic on its made-up house: 6 rooms x $200/wk x (90% - 75%) x 4.35 weeks = $783 a month (index.html #napkin, 'If rooms fill 75% of the time, not 90%: $783 a month off your plan')
lines.shows: the page's canvas: the plan at 90% ($4,698 a month) and the same house at 75% ($3,915); the gap counts to $783 a month off your plan; the arithmetic and 'made-up house' line under it

lines.text: The formula was fine all along. The numbers inside it just had nothing behind them.
lines.claim: The page's napkin: 'The right formula. Two borrowed numbers.' (index.html #napkin)
lines.shows: the napkin card again: the formula line holds steady in navy while the two borrowed numbers glow amber, their tags 'you picked it' and 'a guess'

lines.text: RoomIQ puts evidence behind each of those numbers, before you make the offer.
lines.claim: 'Room rents, how fast rooms fill and nearby supply for one address, each with its evidence' (index.html hero); 'before you make an offer' (index.html #final)
lines.shows: the film rewinds to before the offer (Sold sign lifts, For sale sign back); the RoomIQ tile drops by the house; the product's window slides in, captioned as a product preview on demo data

lines.text: Type in the address, and it counts and maps the co-living houses within about three miles.
lines.source: Nearby supply check (C21, Seen): count and map of active co-living properties within about 3 miles of any address (GTM-BRIEF.md Section 3); demo: 17 within about 3 mi
lines.shows: the Location screen: 1207 Greenway Drive typed into the search; the map's dots light inside the dashed ring; '17 active properties within about 3 mi' highlighted; the same ring and pins on the 3D town

lines.text: Add each room and its bath, and the rent and occupancy come from comparable rooms nearby.
lines.claim: Ledger: 'By bath type and size, from observed rooms nearby'; 'Observed in comparable rooms, with fill times' (index.html #napkin); baseline room mix (index.html screens.baseline)
lines.shows: the Baseline screen's room mix fills in, Room 1 and Room 2 with a private bath; the 3D house opens and its six rooms light cyan one by one with Private bath and Shared bath chips

lines.text: Then it prints the estimate with its formula, its comps, and a label for how sure it is.
lines.source: Revenue forecast for any address (C27, Seen); demo: $224 x 6 x 86.5% x 4.35 weeks = $5,057 a month, 14 comps a median 1.6 mi away, local support, Confidence Medium (index.html screens.forecast)
lines.shows: the forecast's revenue card lifts off the screen: $5,057 a month counts up; the formula prints on 'formula'; '14 comps, local support' on 'comps'; 'Confidence Medium' on 'sure'; the one input to check marked in amber

lines.text: So you're back at the same table with the same formula, and every number has its evidence beside it.
lines.source: Ledger, the RoomIQ version: rent by bath type from observed rooms nearby; occupancy observed in comparable rooms; supply counted within about 3 miles; confidence labeled with the comps (index.html #napkin); demo figures $224, 86.5%, 17, Confidence Medium
lines.shows: the same desk, lamp and camera as the first time; the napkin card again, each question mark replaced by its evidence with a check: $224 a week, 86.5%, 17 within about 3 mi, Confidence Medium

lines.text: You read the label before the number, and you test the deal with your own costs.
lines.claim: 'Read the label before you read the number.' (index.html #evidence); Deal Calculator: cash flow, cash-on-cash, DSCR and cap rate under your own assumptions, informational only (GTM-BRIEF.md Section 5)
lines.shows: the labels on the card light in turn; a deal card: cash flow, cash-on-cash, DSCR and cap rate from your own costs, with 'Informational only. Not financial or lending advice.'

lines.text: Then you make the offer, knowing what each number rests on.
lines.claim: The decision made on evidence; no outcome is claimed (GTM-BRIEF.md Section 5, proof set empty)
lines.shows: she presses Send offer again; the pill 'Offer sent' now carries the evidence; cut to the house: the roof lifts and every room glows cyan with its evidence

lines.text: RoomIQ. See the investment inside the house.
lines.claim: The page's headline (index.html #hero), one of the three site headlines that stay (GTM-BRIEF.md decision 7)
lines.shows: the hero's composition: the forecast screen in its slab, the revenue card lifted, the supply map at its corner, the three guesses drifting away; then the end card: logo, headline, 'Run a free forecast on your address' and the made-up note
